description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing purchase lists within a project. It includes actions for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting purchase lists, as well as managing related ingredients and navigation menus.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::PurchaseList
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing purchase lists within the Coocook project.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Sets up submenu items for navigation related to purchase lists, unassigned items, and shop sections.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of purchase lists with associated URLs and default date calculations.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Fetches a specific purchase list by ID and sets it in the stash, or shows a not found error.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a purchase list, including shop sections and units, and computes next higher/lower values for items.

methods.name: remove_ingredient
methods.description: Removes an ingredient from a purchase list and redirects to the edit page.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new purchase list with a specified date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing purchase list, with validation for duplicates and empty names.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the index action of the purchase list controller.
